description: The bar chart illustrates the Recall@10 values for different components of a conversation recommendation system, comparing the performance of the complete system ("Ours") to its ablated versions. The horizontal axis lists the categories, labeled as "Ours", "- critiquing", "- scoring", and "- ranking", in a specific order, while the vertical axis is labeled with a scale ranging from 0.1 to 0.4. The value axis has a linear scale with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The "Ours" category is represented by an orange bar, reaching approximately 0.34 on the vertical axis, while the other categories are represented by blue bars, with "- critiquing" at around 0.29, "- scoring" at about 0.16, and "- ranking" at approximately 0.23. The bars are not grouped or stacked, and they are not sorted in a specific order, with the categories listed in a particular sequence on the horizontal axis. The chart does not visually emphasize any particular bar through shading, bolding, or outlining.
